The required comprehensive qualitative behavior is not reproduced.

baseline_verification.baseline_genuinely.reason: The implementation includes magnetized electron and ion susceptibility tensors, harmonic sums, electromagnetic driven response, magnetic laser eigenmodes, and coupled pump–seed modal equations. It is not an unmagnetized gain formula with only a susceptibility replacement. Its cold optical-mode and finite-geometry approximations are documented.

The all-data extension improves pooled error by only about 0.1%, supporting the qualified noncompactness finding.
